$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (hitl-approval-rule-action). Declares the approval_request schema backing the human-in-the-loop `approval` rule action type and the Synchronization `sourceConfig.requiresApproval` batch gate. See openspec/changes/hitl-approval-rule-action/design.md#database-changes and specs/approval-workflow/spec.md. `consumedAt` is an addition beyond design.md's table, needed to implement synchronization-engine REQ-015's 'approved, unconsumed approval_request' / 'marked consumed on completion' language precisely — an approved request that gated a synchronization must not silently re-authorize a later run.

approval_request.title: Approval Request
approval_request.summary: A suspended rule-pipeline or Synchronization run awaiting human approve/reject
approval_request.description: Persists the resumable context of a suspended endpoint rule-pipeline run (via the `approval` rule action type) or a gated Synchronization batch (`sourceConfig.requiresApproval`). See openspec/specs/approval-workflow/spec.md.

status.description: State machine: pending -> approved|rejected|expired|dead_letter|error. See approval-workflow REQ-001/003/004/005.
status.title: Status

endpointId.description: FK to the suspended endpoint (endpoint-rule case; null for the Synchronization batch-gate case)
endpointId.title: Endpoint

ruleId.description: FK to the `approval` rule that suspended the run (endpoint-rule case; null for the Synchronization batch-gate case)
ruleId.title: Rule

timing.description: Always 'before' for v1 (design.md Decision 1) — approval only gates pre-write.
timing.title: Timing

resumeOrder.description: The `order` of the approval rule (endpoint-rule case); resume continues with before-phase rules whose `order` is strictly greater. Not applicable to the Synchronization batch-gate case.
resumeOrder.title: Resume Order

snapshot.description: FlowToken::__serialize() output (the 8-key request/response/syncInput/syncOutput array) with sensitive headers (at minimum Authorization) stripped. Empty for the Synchronization batch-gate case.
snapshot.title: Snapshot

synchronizationId.description: FK to the gated Synchronization (batch-gate case); set instead of endpointId/ruleId. See synchronization-engine REQ-015.
synchronizationId.title: Synchronization

requesterUserId.description: NC user id who triggered the original request, or null for unauthenticated/API-key callers
requesterUserId.title: Requester User ID

approverGroup.description: NC group id resolved from the rule's/synchronization's configuration at suspension time
approverGroup.title: Approver Group

onReject.description: Outcome applied when the request is rejected
onReject.title: On Reject

onTimeout.description: Outcome applied when the request expires unresolved
onTimeout.title: On Timeout

approverUserId.description: NC user id who approved/rejected the request
approverUserId.title: Approver User ID

comment.description: Approver comment; required on reject, optional on approve
comment.title: Comment

resumeResult.description: Outcome of the resumed chain, for audit (approval-workflow REQ-003)
resumeResult.title: Resume Result

consumedAt.description: Set when an approved Synchronization batch-gate request's write phase has completed (synchronization-engine REQ-015) — prevents an already-used approval from re-authorizing a later run.
consumedAt.title: Consumed At

createdAt.description: Timestamp the request was created (suspension time)
createdAt.title: Created At
